glosses: savory; plant of the genus Satureja
Satureja, rodzaj aromatycznych roślin rocznych i wieloletnich o bladoliliowych lub białawych kwiatach i lancetowatych liściach; używanych jako przyprawa i do wyrobu leków

examples.text: Cząber bez wątpienia jest jedną z bardziej przydatnych w kuchni przypraw
The fine restaurant presented an array of savory dishes; each was delicious.

glosses: Salty and/or spicy, but not sweet.

examples.text: The mushrooms, meat, bread, rice, peanuts and potatoes were all good savory foods.
The savory rabbit soup contrasted well with the sweet cucumber sandwiches with jam.
Readers are to be warned that quotations in this chapter contain some not so savory language.

The ruthless practices of the Ontario Film Censor Board are by now the laughing stock of most of the world. Scenes that contain more flesh or affection than they find savoury are simply hacked out of the film before it is released.
On Friday the pastry chef Pichet Ong will open his own cafe, with sweets and savories served at tables and a counter.

glosses: Any of several Mediterranean herbs, of the genus Satureja, grown as culinary flavourings.

examples.text: There are some who advise taking the noxious herb savory; in my judgment it is poison.

glosses: The leaves of these plants used as a flavouring.
bladeren van Satureja hortensis en Satureja montana, gebruikt als keukenkruid
eine Pflanze aus der Gattung Satureja, die teilweise als Küchenkraut verwendet wird

examples.text: Die meisten Bohnenkräuter kommen in den temperaten Gebieten und den tropischen Gebirgen vor.
Das Bohnenkraut passt sehr gut zu Bohnen, Kartoffeln und Salat.

glosses: erba dai fiori bianchi o lilla, molto apprezzata come condimento culinario, soprattutto per cucinare i fagiolini
